items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I was supposed to play from one to, with Charlotte, Charlotte's job, piano player.

ctx.x: That was the last time you were.

What I mean, you asked me about a job that I worked on, well I'm telling you, you understand. You understand what I'm saying? Well see, I could have worked on a lot of jobs, but to tell you, it didn't pay. You see what I'm talking about? Because I could do better, but what I was doing, see because Congressman Boggs and all them kind of people, they paid me $10 to $15 an hour just to walk around with that guitar and play. You understand? You understand? 1729 Poist Street when they'd be in town and all them people,…
